[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Security model"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- All `/api/skin-center/*` routes are same-origin only: writes reject cross-site requests (Sec-Fetch"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"-Site / Origin fence), and asset reads are contained inside each skin directory (path escapes fail c"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"losed).
- Skin CSS is sanitized (whitelist) before serving; `patches.css` (L3) is arbitrary CSS by d"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"esign and disclosed as such — it runs with full page styling power and is not a security boundary.
-"},{"id":"p16s5","text":" The CSS safety pipeline runs in a short-lived worker process, one worker per request, and the worke"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"r has exited before the stylesheet response is written. The host process therefore never loads the C"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"SS parser and never maps its native addon, which is what lets a package manager replace the parser p"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"ackage while the host runs (issue #98).
- The pipeline belongs to one plugin mount: the mount create"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"s it, injects it into the routes and disposes it with the mount. A remount therefore gets its own pi"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"peline, and tearing down the old mount never disables the new one.
- The pipeline holds at most eigh"},{"id":"p16s11","text":"t requests in total, the running one and the waiting ones alike. A request beyond that cap is refuse"},{"id":"p16s12","text":"d at once with `503 css-transform-overloaded`; a whitelist violation is still `422`, every other tra"},{"id":"p16s13","text":"nsform failure is still `500`.
- No request can hang: every request carries a ten-second budget that"},{"id":"p16s14","text":" also covers a worker that answered but refuses to exit, and a worker that cannot be started fails t"},{"id":"p16s15","text":"he request immediately instead of waiting for the budget.
- The custom-theme editor emits only fixed"},{"id":"p16s16","text":" declarations from `CUSTOM_THEME_ALLOWED_TOKENS`, each verified against the official token registry."},{"id":"p16s17","text":" User input is normalized color/contrast data and never becomes a selector, URL or free-form CSS pay"},{"id":"p16s18","text":" normalized color/contrast data and never becomes a selector, URL or free-form CSS payload.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- Inline styles written by plugins at runtime can only be overridden by L3 `!important` patches.
- P"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"lugins that do not output semantic attributes (and have no stable DOM anchors) receive L1 token cove"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"rage only.
- Wallpaper pause-on-hidden, wallpaper blur, dimming and sound live in `dsh-plugin-wallpa"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"per-engine`'s own settings; the skin center has no wallpaper controls and its card only reports the "},{"id":"p18s5","text":"plugin's state.
- While one stylesheet transform is running, the worker process holds the CSS parser"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"'s native addon, and a package install in that exact window still sees a mapped addon on Windows. Th"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"e window lasts one transform; the host process itself never holds it.
- A burst of more than eight s"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"tylesheet requests is refused with `503` for the requests beyond the cap; the client has to retry th"},{"id":"p18s9","text":"esheet requests is refused with `503` for the requests beyond the cap; the client has to retry them."}],"truncated":true}
